comment: The plugin description calls this a 3-oscillator VCO; the code runs two shape oscillators plus a sine taken from oscillator A. The README says 0V is middle C, which holds when an octave knob is at -1: the pitch fed to the oscillator is the knob value plus one, and the knobs come up at -2 for A and -1 for B. The two SHAPE CV inputs read channel one only, while the PW CV inputs are read per channel.
